name: Safespring Storage (S3)
tax_note: The price page does not say whether prices include VAT.

regions.note: 'Swedish secondary site - https://s3.sto2.safedc.net'; city not stated.

storage_classes.name: S3-storage

price.note: Price page, Safespring Storage (S3): 'S3-storage' ('Tailored for applications that actively use the S3 protocol') 44,50 € 'Per TB for 30 days'. Not converted to GB because the page does not define TB (1000 or 1024 GB). One price is listed without site distinction.

put_per_1000.note: The price page lists no request fee for Safespring Storage (S3); absence of a fee line, not an explicit statement that requests are free.

price_per_gb.note: No retrieval fee line on the price page.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Not stated on the price page or docs checked.

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Not stated on the price page or docs checked.

notes: Default quotas: 10 buckets per project, 1 million objects and 1 TB per bucket, optimal object size 1 MB (quota page).

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Not stated on the price page or docs checked.

notes: Separate S3 account requested from support; designed for bigger objects written once and read occasionally. Default quotas: 2 buckets, 1 million objects and 32 TB per bucket, optimal object size 32 MB (quota page).

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: Not a capped allowance: all traffic is free (see price_per_gb).

price.note: Price page, 'No Traffic Cost': 'Safespring does not charge any traffic cost for data sent to or from our services.' The Network section also lists 'data traffic (ingress and egress) at no extra cost'.

egress_fair_use.note: No fair-use limit on traffic is stated on the price page.

free_tier.note: No free tier or trial for Storage is stated on the price page.

object_lock.note: Object locking page: 'Object locking is a new feature, that exists for certain test accounts at Safespring storage.' COMPLIANCE and GOVERNANCE modes are documented, but general availability is not stated (https://docs.safespring.com/storage/object-locking/).

s3_endpoints.label: Norwegian site
s3_endpoints.note: Compatibility matrix: path-style access is the 'Default and the only one supported'; virtual-hosted style is not supported (https://docs.safespring.com/storage/s3-compatibility/). Region values are not used by the endpoints; us-east-1 is accepted (https://docs.safespring.com/storage/howto/configs/aws-cli/).

s3_endpoints.note: Compatibility matrix: path-style access is the 'Default and the only one supported'; virtual-hosted style is not supported (https://docs.safespring.com/storage/s3-compatibility/). Region values are not used by the endpoints; us-east-1 is accepted (https://docs.safespring.com/storage/howto/configs/aws-cli/).

notes: No self-service sign-up: S3 Storage credentials come with a Safespring Compute project; the archive tier needs a separate account from support (getting-started page).
Storage prices are listed per TB per 30 days and are left null per GB until the TB definition is confirmed: S3-storage 44,50 €, S3-archive 31,15 €.
An optional SUPPORT-standard level is billed at 3 % of total volume (price page); SUPPORT-base costs 0,00 €.
